claude_proposed_widenings.name: ProficiencyGrantSubject.expertise
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Expertise (double PB on skill checks) is mechanically distinct from regular proficiency (single PB). The current ProficiencyGrantSubject union only has 'skill' (proficiency), 'weapon_category', and 'armor_category'. There is no way to express 'expertise in a skill' versus 'proficiency in a skill'. A new variant { kind: 'skill_expertise'; skill: Skill } (or a level field on the existing skill variant) is needed to honestly encode this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain Expertise in those skills.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ProficiencyGrant.from_existing_proficiencies
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Expertise grant requires the player to choose from skills they are already proficient in. The current ProficiencyGrant.choice variant requires a static options list authored at content-creation time. A new choice mode that expresses 'choose N from your currently proficient skills' is needed to honestly encode the character-state-dependent selection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose two of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise.
